patches.subject: qwen4exp: fix CUDA decode depth-decay at long context (re: ggml-org/llama.cpp#28734)
qwen4exp: compact-gather attention for decode — quantized KV keeps the sparse speedup (re: ggml-org/llama.cpp#28734)
server: keep busy slots on contiguous sequence ids (seq compaction)
server: prefill admission policy (max-partial / long-threshold / max-long) + waiting metrics
pipeline parallelism for the qwen4exp hybrid: keep ubatches overlapping across GPUs
ggml-backend: GGML_SCHED_N_COPIES env to limit pipeline input copies (memory vs depth)
graph: build the causal KQ mask on the device from cell positions (LLAMA_KQ_MASK_DEVICE)
qwen4exp: build the QSA block bias on the device (LLAMA_QSA_BIAS_DEVICE)
memory-hybrid-idx: LLAMA_DECODE_PIPELINE=1 splits a pure multi-sequence decode batch into per-sequence ubatches
stream-agnostic decode graph for per-sequence decode ubatches (LLAMA_DECODE_PIPELINE=1)
LLAMA_UBATCH_TRACE=1: per-ubatch reuse/reserve/timing and per-split host-wait trace (debug aid)
ggml-backend: stage scheduler inputs through rotating pinned buffers and copy them asynchronously on the compute stream
ggml-backend: one staging offset per backend per compute, not per split
ggml-backend: grow the staging slots geometrically, and a GGML_SCHED_STAGE_WAIT bisection knob
ggml-backend: the source stream of a cross-backend hop copy waits for the destination's previous split (reused-graph pipelining fix; GGML_SCHED_NO_HOP_WAIT=1 disables)
ggml-backend: stage scheduler inputs only for reused graphs (a freshly allocated graph has a fresh copy slot); GGML_SCHED_STAGE_INPUTS=2 stages always
scheduler input staging only for pipelined decode ubatches (ggml_backend_sched_set_stage_inputs, set per ubatch by llama_context); solo decode and prefill use the plain synchronous copies
server: LLAMA_SERVER_TIMINGS=1 enables the per-phase update_slots timing report at runtime (5 s windows, reset after each report)

phase 2: multiple in-flight batches (llama_output_slots_set/llama_output_slot/llama_output_select: per-batch output regions and completion events) and server pipelined decode groups (LLAMA_SERVER_GROUPS=n): one group sampled and re-issued per update_slots while the others compute
server: member-wise server_batch::swap for parking pipelined-group batches (std::swap double-freed the llama_batch arrays)

LLAMA_DECODE_PIPELINE=2: single-sequence decode batches also take the stream-agnostic class with a cache-wide n_kv floor (one graph for all pipelined-group batches); the server sets it when groups are on
trace: mem_hybrid reuse reject detail
decode pipeline level read live from the environment (the static was captured by the warmup decode before the server set level 2)
trace full synchronize while output slots are in use; timing report must not synchronize in group mode
backend-sampling getters wait only for the selected output batch (the common sampler probes them on every token; the full synchronize serialized pipelined groups)
common sampler waits only for the selected output batch (llama_output_synchronize) instead of a full synchronize per token
server groups: skip groups without work, per-stream graph class while a single slot is active
server groups: chunk prefill to one ubatch and one slot while other slots generate
context: reserve compute buffers once per ubatch shape class
sched: do not drain the pipeline when the graph layout changes
server groups: eager prefill chunks; sched: pre-allocated 12-slot staging ring
sched: synchronize before an unstaged host copy after a re-plan; server: eager prefill off by default
safe defaults: scheduler drain on re-plan, prefill chunking off
sched: cover the user's asynchronous output read-outs with the completion events; non-draining re-plan and 256-token prefill chunks by default
sched: keep the re-plan safety window open for several computes
sched: order re-planned computes after other-plan computes only; server: chunk only while decoders outnumber prefills
WIP (not compiled): asynchronous prompt-cache save/restore
server: drain-free context checkpoints, pinned staging for state transfers, idle saves spread out
server: finish asynchronous state transfers even when no slot is processing
server: a task whose best-matching slot is being saved waits for it
server: cheap prompt-cache save start (shared checkpoint bytes, off-thread frees)
llama: staged state copies on several threads (LLAMA_STATE_XFER_THREADS)
server: release a parked batch's output slot even when its logits were never read
server: n-gram speculation with decode groups, recurrent-state snapshots instead of host checkpoints
speculative: fresh n-gram map per new prompt; server: cap on the number of drafting users
server: acceptance gate for speculative drafts
llama: portable std::max in output_reserve (gcc 13 rejects the explicit-template brace-list form)
